name: Brownstone
clues: Strong ghost room clues in the upper floor
Closet interactions can expose aggressive hunts
ghostHints: Ritual circles often seen once a ghost has multiple evidence signals
Phasman-type hunts often pause near the hallway

name: Tanglewood Street House
clues: Long hallways, multiple vent shafts, easy to misread footsteps
High event variety in first 2 minutes
ghostHints: Spirit Box and D.O.T.S. frequently line up quickly
Freezing drops are common in closed rooms

name: Ridgeview Road
clues: Open courtyard allows EMF flickers to read from short distances
Cold spots appear near the porch and back stairwell
ghostHints: Often hides evidence behind doors; use UV and Spirit Box together
Doorway evidence reads can fail in heavy weather events

name: Edgefield
clues: Fast movement checks happen around the kitchen side
Sanity drains faster during map traversal
ghostHints: Ghost writing is more reliable on wooden furniture
Avoid resetting too many windows for low evidence confidence

name: Willow Street House
clues: Low ambient light, good for orb-heavy runs
Multiple false negatives with EMF 5 if too far
ghostHints: Use close-range finger tracking on the stairs
D.O.T.S. can trigger outside the active room

name: Hanging Hill
clues: Cold events can stack with EMF events
ghostHints: UV is usually clean near hallway intersections
Watch for evidence spikes at the moment of hunt
